summary: Resumed review restored exact proposal, functionality document and canonical/rendered source evidence. All four proposed changes independently supported; all eight upstream non-retain dispositions reconciled, including five accepted compiled-evidence deferrals. No overrides or repairs needed. Supported retained research is explicitly inherited; acceptance is limited to changes and examined contradictions.

proposed_facts.reason: Activate accurately distinguishes restarting animation, replacing the countdown and setting activity from the separate suppression-clear operation. Canonical behavior supports resolving the rendered Show collision.
Deactivate accurately identifies clearing activity alone, unlike the neighboring suppression setter. It resolves the rendered Hide collision without implying countdown reset.
The suppression setter changes only its latch; rendering tests that latch independently of activity. Both the paired control and constructor clear it, while the process callback does not.

The complete constructor supports the described descriptor flow, callback registration, state resets and pointer overwrite. It neither resets the countdown nor locally releases an earlier object; only selector 0 adjusts X. Descriptor non-retention is correctly limited to this unit, leaving downstream lifetimes unresolved.

contradictions.reason: Accepted deferral for fact:b21234dd-c74b-40e2-afa9-c83e0e500db9: declarations support state types and roles, but address comments do not prove a contiguous compiled 16-byte block or offsets.

Accepted deferrals for fact:8e9830f6-77c0-49be-8011-da41b6450bcd, fact:4c0d5397-51c7-488e-ad15-621b475dad79 and fact:e66e94d3-d88c-4e4f-a841-342082d78ff3: constructor/helper calls cannot establish diagnostic-string section membership, a 13-byte section size, pooling or padding.
Accepted deferral for fact:d082cacc-be6a-4b9b-a248-abd84af13337: animation frame zero and the 18.0f translation offset are supported, but an exact eight-byte compiled literal pool is not.

Accepted supersession of fact:4261b496-3a68-4d15-85c0-5acb224b29dc and fact:8903fd88-0e99-4bbb-a42f-5d7093879c7e: canonical assignments distinguish activation/deactivation from suppression clearing/setting, supporting the proposed names rather than relying on rendered hypotheses.
Accepted correction of fact:bbc6bee5-fdb7-45ce-851e-041cfc05a140: the paired control is not the sole suppression-reset path; construction explicitly clears the latch too.

unresolved: Revision-matched compiled evidence is still required for section sizes, offsets, diagnostic-string placement, pooling, padding and literal representation.
External object destruction and descriptor/resource lifetimes across teardown or repeated construction remain outside the demonstrated local behavior.
